statements.status_notes: GitHub advisory GHSA-qqj6-54q6-cxv6 documents CVE-2026-86597 (sensitive data in Snowflake Go driver log files). The fix is available in github.com/snowflakedb/gosnowflake v2.2.0. This image links the v1 module at 1.19.1 into Alloy for optional Snowflake telemetry components; adopting v2 is a major-module migration. Compatibility assessment and a rebuild of the catalog alloy package are pending.
